ClientCapabilities.description: Capabilities a client may support. Known capabilities are defined here, in this schema, but this is not a closed set: any client can define its own, additional capabilities.

elicitation.description: Present if the client supports elicitation from the server.

experimental.description: Experimental, non-standard capabilities that the client supports.

roots.description: Present if the client supports listing roots.

listChanged.description: Whether the client supports notifications for changes to the roots list.

sampling.description: Present if the client supports sampling from an LLM.

Implementation.description: Describes the name and version of an MCP implementation, with an optional title for UI representation.

name.description: Intended for programmatic or logical use, but used as a display name in past specs or fallback (if title isn't present).

title.description:
Intended for UI and end-user contexts — optimized to be human-readable and easily understood,
even by those unfamiliar with domain-specific terminology.

If not provided, the name should be used for display (except for Tool,
where `annotations.title` should be given precedence over using `name`,
if present).

InitializeRequest.description: This request is sent from the client to the server when it first connects, asking it to begin initialization.

protocolVersion.description: The latest version of the Model Context Protocol that the client supports. The client MAY decide to support older versions as well.

InitializedNotification.description: This notification is sent from the client to the server after initialization has finished.

JSONRPCNotification.description: A notification which does not expect a response.

JSONRPCRequest.description: A request that expects a response.

progressToken.description: If specified, the caller is requesting out-of-band progress notifications for this request (as represented by notifications/progress). The value of this parameter is an opaque token that will be attached to any subsequent notifications. The receiver is not obligated to provide these notifications.

ProgressToken.description: A progress token, used to associate progress notifications with the original request.

RequestId.description: A uniquely identifying ID for a request in JSON-RPC.
